Email Signature Detection to extract Name and Email from Signature in email body.
- We will be using locally downloaded dslim/bert-base-NER model
- Email body will be in text form.

Task 1 - Create Data set
1. Create small sample email data set of JSON type as emails can have comma and CSV format will not work.
2. Data set format should be 2 fields - 1. message_id (numeric indicating message sequence number), 2. content (text as email body)
3. Sample data should have 1 or 2 emails that has no signature.
4. Some data will email signature as well as multiple other emails being referenced in body of email
5. Some data will multiple names in Email body besides one in signature.
56 Some data will have multiple names in Email body but missing in signature and signature will have just email.

Data Pre-Processing tasks -
1. Identify emails without signature, for example body does no have @ char that means there is no email, extract them in seperate edge case data as missing signature data and exclude them from main data, list count of such finding.
2. Identify emails with multiple emails in body, say multiple @ chars far apart in email body, extract them in seperate edge case data as multiple emails data and exclude them from main data, list count of such finding.
3. Remove all control chars like (\n, \r, \t and others embedded in email body.
4. Data should be split in to train, validation and test.

NER Model Prepartion and Customization -
1. Create a custom Entity called EML that can identify valid email address using regex.
2. Train custom finetuned NER Model to extract PER and EML entities from train data.
3. Validate using validation dataset.
4. Run final model on test data.
5. Collect findings from model run on test data in seperate data set as message_id, name, email
6. Summarize number of messages for which name or email could not be identified

Generate all of items with details in previous prompt and zip entire data and code with all the details from chat in seperate markdown README.md file

lets use Clean Data, perform 1-6 taskes from "NER Model Prepartion and Customization" part of earlier prompt, put code in ner_model_evaluation.py for download

Lets move on with annotations for PER labels and review model metrics, also show confusion matrix and model performance graph.
zip everything in zip file, including all of prompt responses.

Types of Splits
1. train/test and Cross Validation on train set
2. train/validation/test
3. train/validation/test cv on train
